# Write-free e2e: version (text + JSON schema fields).
# cwd: $WORK (fresh). No FS mutation expected.

# Text mode — required fields for agents/tools.
exec foundry version
stdout 'foundry '
stdout 'commit:'
stdout 'go:'
stdout 'catalog_digest:'
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# JSON mode — envelope + result fields; stderr exclusive ownership of failures only.
exec foundry version --output json
stdout '"schema":1'
stdout '"command":"version"'
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"version"'
stdout '"commit"'
stdout '"go"'
stdout '"catalog_digest"'
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# Quiet suppresses human text; still exit 0.
exec foundry version --quiet
! stdout .
! stderr .
